verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents two free, self-serve generator tools built on Contract Express: the SCC Generator and the German Term Sheet Generator. Each uses an interactive, step-by-step questionnaire to assemble real legal documents (modular EU Standard Contractual Clauses and an early-round term sheet), and the SCC tool integrates with Docusign for paperless execution. This is interactive document assembly, not static templates. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the tools work as described (all evidence is first-party), and the evidence covers only two narrow document types (the term sheet is explicitly 'simplified').

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
